CDISC-CG0001.Description: Raise an error when the DOMAIN value of a non-custom domain is not a Domain Code published by CDISC in the "SDTM Domain Abbreviations" controlled terminology codelist.

Check.expression: $domain_is_custom == false and var_ccode("DEFINE") == "C66734" and var_codelist_coded_codes("DEFINE") not in $domain_lib_ccode

Outcome.Message: DOMAIN is not a valid Domain Code published by CDISC in the SDTM Domain Abbreviations controlled terminology.

CDISC-CG0010.Description: Raise an error when the variable role specified in the Define-XML does not match the variable role defined in the SDTMIG (for domains in the IG) or in the SDTM model (for custom domains).

Check.expression: not empty(var_role("LIBRARY")) and not empty(var_name("DEFINE")) and var_role("DEFINE") != var_role("LIBRARY")

Outcome.Message: The variable role specified in the Define-XML does not match the variable role in the SDTMIG (for domains in the IG) or in the SDTM model (for custom domains).
